description: PROP-BILL-057 (health check) test in cross-cutting.test.ts (lines 147-172) defines a local function buildHealthResponse() inside the test and asserts against it. This is a tautological test -- it tests a function written inside the test itself, not any production code. There is no actual health check endpoint implementation in the billing-service source files, and the test proves nothing about real system behavior. Similarly, PROP-BILL-058 (service boundary) tests at lines 177-218 hardcode a string array of method names and check that none contain 'payjp_event' or 'impact_log' -- this is a static string check, not a verification of actual runtime behavior.
remediation: The contract must flag that PROP-BILL-057 and PROP-BILL-058 require actual integration tests against production code, not tautological assertions. Either (a) defer these to Tier 3 manual verification with explicit contract criteria, or (b) require real health check endpoint implementation and real DB-backed service boundary tests.
